subtitle: High-risk actions waiting for a distinct human approver. Eligible approvers can record a decision here or in a supported channel.
mechanicsBody: High-risk work stays parked until a distinct approver acts. FDAI Console records the human decision and queues it for Var; it never executes the action.
errorExpired: This approval expired before the decision was recorded. Nothing was changed; refresh the queue to see the current request.
errorAlreadyResolved: This approval was already decided. Refresh the queue to see its current state.
errorServer: The server could not record the decision. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.
decisionDelivered: {decision} was recorded and delivered to the approval workflow.
decisionPendingDelivery: {decision} was recorded. Durable delivery is pending and will be retried.
decisionUnavailable: This legacy or incomplete approval cannot be decided from FDAI Console.
sampleReason: A distinct operator must approve this VM start.
sampleStopCondition: Checkout health remains below the objective after startup.
contactTitle: Approval requests waiting for your consent
contactBody: FDAI found an eligible approver through your confirmed reporting line. Sending the request does not approve the action.
contactQueued: Your choice was recorded. The approval route will be rechecked before any message is sent.
contactEmpty: No approval request is waiting for your contact consent.
slackUnavailable: The Slack handoff cannot be used. Open a new approval request in Slack.
slackRecorded: Your decision was recorded. Delivery and effect are verified separately.
slackFreshness: Sign in again with Entra after the Slack click. A cached session cannot authorize this decision.
developmentNote: The full-authority development profile lets you approve your own request after a fresh sign-in. Your approval covers only this exact action, target revision, and dry run.
developmentReady: You signed in again. Record your approval within 10 minutes.
developmentOwnerOnly: Only the development Owner who requested this action can approve it. Other approvers can reject it.
justificationPlaceholder: Optional context for the audit log (for example, ticket reference or verification check)
